# Ida Bagus Dwiweka Naratama

> M.S. Candidate in Robotics, Kwangwoon University. Robotics and AI researcher building perception, spatial-reasoning and navigation systems for mobile robots, covering computer vision, multimodal and generative AI, 3D scene understanding, SLAM and autonomous navigation, from model development to deployment on real robots.

## Education
- M.S. in Robotics, Kwangwoon University, Seoul, South Korea. Feb 2025 – Feb 2027 (expected). GPA 4.5 / 4.5. Advised by Prof. Junghyun Oh, Robotics & AI Lab.
- Bachelor's in Information Technology, Udayana University, Bali, Indonesia. Aug 2019 – Apr 2023. GPA 3.93 / 4.0, cum laude. Thesis on extractive text summarization using a textual entailment approach based on deep learning.

## Experience
- Graduate Researcher, Robotics & AI Lab (RAIL), Kwangwoon University, Seoul, South Korea. Feb 2025 – Present.
  - Research on AI-based perception, spatial reasoning and navigation for mobile robots.
  - Built an uncertainty-aware object-goal navigation framework with ensemble semantic-map prediction and exploration planning, reaching a 64.0% success rate across 500 HM3D episodes and outperforming deterministic semantic baselines.
  - Developed LatentSGC (graph neural networks + conditional flow matching) for generative 3D scene graph completion, raising node F1 from 0.245 to 0.432 and edge F1 from 0.089 to 0.255 over deterministic baselines.
  - Reimplemented a task-driven open-set 3D scene graph pipeline and deployed it on an AgileX Scout Mini with ROS 2 and Nav2.
  - Built reproducible simulation pipelines with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, ROS 2, SLAM Toolbox, AMCL and Nav2, where selected configurations reached 100% navigation success across repeated construction-site trials.
- AI Engineer, PukulEnam.ai, Bali, Indonesia. Jan 2024 – Sep 2024.
  - Built a Llama 3 virtual teaching assistant with edge deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano, and LLM applications using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the OpenAI API.
  - Increased the frame rate of DICOM medical image sequences with FiNNiGAN and SRGAN super-resolution, outperforming interpolation.
  - Built a custom U-Net for anomaly detection on ACDC 2017 (cross-entropy, focal, Dice and Lovász losses) and applied the OWAD framework to malware anomaly detection, benchmarked against random forest and decision tree models.
- NLP Researcher (Professor's Assistant), Udayana University, Bali, Indonesia. Jul 2022 – Mar 2023.
  - Adapted the SNLI natural-language-inference dataset to Indonesian.
  - Built NLI models with BiLSTM, self-attention and multi-head attention using Stanza, FastText, GloVe, Word2Vec and BERT.

## Teaching & mentoring
- Machine Learning Path Mentor, Bangkit Academy, Indonesia. Feb 2023 – Jul 2024.
  - Mentored 75 students across three cohorts of 25 in the machine learning path.
  - Coordinated in-person instructor-led training sessions.
  - Recognised as “Study Squad Dynamo” and “Energetic Guide Mentor”.
- Machine Learning Mentor, Indonesia AI, Depok, Indonesia. Feb 2024 – Aug 2024.
  - Taught time-series forecasting (ARIMA, LSTM) across 12 classes for 20 participants, with one-on-one mentoring sessions.

## Projects
- Graph-Space Conformal Prediction for 3D Scene Graph Completion (research, 2026; First author). Calibrated prediction regions over whole scene-graph hypotheses, reaching 89.95% coverage at a 90% target across 1,015 rooms from HM3D, 3RScan and MP3D. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/conformal-scene-graph/
- Uncertainty-Driven Exploration for Object-Goal Navigation (research, 2025 – 2026; First author). An ensemble of semantic-map predictors turns disagreement over unseen space into an exploration signal, reaching a 64.0% success rate and 0.3228 SPL on HM3D. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/uncertainty-map-exploration/
- Latent Flow Matching for 3D Scene Graph Completion (LatentSGC) (research, 2026; First author). A graph autoencoder with conditional flow matching completes unobserved objects and relations, reaching node F1 0.432 and edge F1 0.255 (+0.187 and +0.166 over deterministic baselines). https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/latent-flow-scene-graph/
- VQ-LaMa for Discrete Semantic Map Inpainting (research, 2026; First author). Adds vector quantization to LaMa so semantic-map completion composes walls, corners and corridors from a learned codebook, giving sharper, more consistent maps for exploration. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/vq-lama/
- Simulation Framework for Construction-Site Quadruped Navigation (research, 2025; First author). Isaac Sim + ROS 2 + Nav2 pipeline for repeatable quadruped navigation tests. Tuned parameters reached 100% success over 30 trials per configuration. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/construction-site-quadruped/
- Attention-Guided Semantic Navigation with Exponential Rewards (research, 2025; Co-author). A confidence module fuses channel and spatial attention over semantic maps with CLIP goal-text and pose embeddings to score frontiers, trained with an exponential coverage reward. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/attention-semantic-navigation/
- LLM-Assisted Object Target Prediction for Navigation (research, 2025; Co-author). GPT-4o validates Mask R-CNN object predictions before they enter the semantic map, filtering false positives and improving success rate and trajectory efficiency on HM3D. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/llm-object-navigation/
- Open-Set 3D Scene Graphs on a Mobile Robot (engineering, Kwangwoon University; Robotics engineer). Reimplemented a task-driven open-set 3D scene graph pipeline and deployed it on an AgileX Scout Mini with ROS 2 and Nav2. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/scout-mini-scene-graph/
- Text Summarization with Textual Entailment (engineering, Mar 2023; Sole developer). My undergraduate thesis, an extractive summarizer driven by a natural-language-inference model and served as a Flask web app. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/text-summarization/
- Tanam.in, a Gardening App with Plant Recognition (engineering, Jul 2022; Machine learning). Android gardening-education app on Google Cloud. Transfer-learning models identify vegetables and fruits and detect tomato and chili leaf diseases. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/tanam-in/
- Information Retrieval Application (engineering, Nov 2021; Developer). Desktop search engine over text documents combining Boolean queries, TF-IDF, Jaccard, n-grams, cosine distance and the extended Boolean model. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/information-retrieval/
- Computer Vision Toolkit (engineering, Nov 2021; Developer). Desktop image-processing app for thresholding, morphology, Sobel, Laplacian and Canny edge detection, plus line and circle detection. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/computer-vision-app/
- Food Sentiment Analysis with the Twitter API (engineering, Jun 2021; Developer). End-to-end big-data pipeline that collects tweets about popular Indonesian dishes via the Twitter API, stores them in MongoDB, scores them with TextBlob and visualises the results in Tableau. https://dwiwekan.github.io/portfolio/projects/food-sentiment-analysis/
